name: Sodium perchlorate
description: Sodium perchlorate (CAS 7601-89-0 ), also known commercially as perchloric acid sodium salt, is a highly soluble inorganic oxidizer sourced for applications where strong oxidizing capacity must be managed. It is a primary raw material in energetic material synthesis and specialty electrochemical systems. In aerospace and defense, this chemical serves as a precursor in the production of ammonium perchlorate, the dominant oxidizer in solid rocket propellants and pyrotechnic compositions. Electronics manufacturers use it in electrolyte formulations for lithium battery research. Its high ionic conductivity in solution is the deciding factor for electrochemical testing. It also appears in airbag inflator chemistry and other gas-generating systems requiring a reliable, fast-reacting oxidant for safety mechanisms. Specialty chemical producers use it as an intermediate in synthesizing other perchlorate salts for analytical and industrial applications. Sodium perchlorate is supplied as a white crystalline powder or as an anhydrous solid depending on requirements. The monohydrate form is also available depending on specific processing needs. Technical grade is the standard commercial offering, with purity levels typically at 99% or higher for industrial use across various sectors. As a regulated oxidizer classified under UN1502, it is handled and shipped under hazardous goods protocols.
